name: Conditional Radiance Field with Shared Branch
definition: A neural radiance field architecture designed for shape and color disentanglement, enabling efficient editing by allowing specific submodules to be finetuned. It maps a 3D location x, viewing direction d, and instance-specific shape code z(s) and color code z(c) to radiance c and scalar density σ.
summary: The Conditional Radiance Field with Shared Branch is a neural radiance field architecture that separates shape representation into category-specific and instance-specific branches to enable efficient, independent editing of shape and color.
